name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio: Mateo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines in his family's auto repair shop in Buenos Aires. He quickly developed a knack for understanding complex systems and optimizing workflows. After earning a degree in industrial engineering, he honed his logistics skills in the automotive manufacturing sector before making the leap to racing. He believes meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving are the keys to seamless race weekend execution. Mateo prides himself on anticipating potential challenges and having contingency plans in place, ensuring the team always has what they need, when they need it.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: He has a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and meticulously records every detail.
Has a specific playlist for different stages of a race weekend to maintain focus.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, even in the chaos of the paddock.
